title: 15-minute exec briefing: consequence matrix + triggered rollback playbook
creator: Avery Chen
description: Produce a concise 15-minute executive packet that ties current initiative health (inference cost reduction, latency SLOs, Dedicated capacity uptake) to OKR deltas and a clear set of tiered asks for the board/steering committee. Deliverables: 1) a one-slide consequence matrix that maps metric thresholds to recommended actions; 2) a triggered rollback playbook (if model/quantization changes regress quality or latency); 3) an ask ladder with cost/reliability trade-offs and funding ask ranges. The goal is to make the exec slot decision-ready with minimal follow-up questions.
acceptance_criteria: One-page slide with consequence matrix and clear metric thresholds
Rollback playbook documented with owner and runbook links
Ask ladder includes three funding scenarios (base / accelerate / contingency) with expected ROI and SLO impact
Deck reviewed by Eng and Reliability and sign-off from Design for slide clarity
Dry-run completed with exec sponsor and feedback incorporated
updates: 2026-03-04 - Kickoff: scoped deliverables with Eng (R. Singh) and Reliability (M. Alvarez). Agreed metric set: p50/p95 latency, unit cost per 1K tokens, pct of requests using KV cache. (Avery)
2026-03-06 - Eng provided simulated runbook for rollback triggers (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ops-runbooks/pull/312). Noted two false-positive scenarios; follow-up to tighten signal. (Ravi)
2026-03-08 - Design (L. Kim) delivered slide prototype; asked to simplify consequence matrix to 3x3 grid and add color-blind friendly palette. (Avery)
2026-03-09 - Reliability requested including recent SLO burn chart; linked dashboard updated: https://dash.redwood-inference.com/d/ops/slo-burn. Included latency regression canditates. (M. Alvarez)
2026-03-11 - PM review with exec sponsor (C. Navarro): sponsor prefers ask ladder to start with a small, time-boxed pilot ask. Revised ask ladder accordingly. (Ravi)
2026-03-12 - Dry-run scheduled for 2026-03-18 with Eng, Reliability, and CFO office. Added contingency asks and fallback policies to playbook. (Avery)
decisions: Use three metric thresholds for consequence matrix: Green (OK), Amber (degraded, trigger accelerated telemetry), Red (stop new rollouts + rollback candidate)
Rollback playbook will be automated up to the step of pausing rollouts; human approval required for full capacity rollback
Ask ladder structured as: Base (no additional $), Accelerate (+$250k/Q for Dedicated capacity), Contingency (+$500k/Q for emergency runway)
Quality checks: add a 50-sample human eval probe and automated prompt-set regression; failing either moves signal to Amber
follow_up_tasks: Finalize one-slide PDF and export as single A4 for board packet by 2026-03-17
Implement tighter signal thresholds in ENG-18223 and validate against last 30 days of traffic
Schedule dry-run with CFO and Legal on 2026-03-18; collect feedback and finalize asks
Create a short GitHub runbook PR that wires the rollback playbook into Canary controller (PR link to follow)
Attach design artifacts and accessibility notes to Confluence page
risks: Metric noise causing spurious rollback triggers — mitigation: additive smoothing + 5min confirmation window
Exec asks perceived as premature without a clear ROI line — mitigation: include conservative ROI and short pilot option
Automated rollback could interrupt high-value customer jobs — mitigation: whitelist critical customers and require manual approval for those orgs
